categoryDescriptions.Yazılım: Programming languages, web and backend development, data structures and algorithms. Project-based, hands-on software courses for everyone from beginners to professional developers.
categoryDescriptions.Sosyal Bilimler: History, the history of the Republic and the social sciences. Courses that read events through their sources and their causes, building critical thinking and interpretation.
categoryDescriptions.Fen Bilimleri: Physics, chemistry, biology and astronomy. Science courses at high-school and university-prep level that explain nature through experiment, observation and modelling.
categoryDescriptions.Yabancı Dil: Levelled language courses from A1 to B2, mainly English and German. Listening, speaking, reading and writing, practised through everyday and workplace situations.
categoryDescriptions.Sanat: Pencil drawing, sketching, colour theory and art history. Studio lessons that train observation and the hand, and teach you to read artworks in their period and context.
categoryDescriptions.Müzik: Piano, guitar and basic music theory. Levelled instrument lessons, from reading notes to rhythm and harmony, from your first piece to playing on stage.
categoryDescriptions.Spor: Physical education, functional training and healthy living. Programmes that teach good technique, injury prevention and a training habit you can keep.
categoryDescriptions.Tasarım: UI/UX, graphic design and typography. Design courses for digital and print, from user research and prototyping to visual hierarchy and brand identity.
categoryDescriptions.Genel: Effective study techniques, time management and general knowledge. Cross-subject skills that support learning in every field.
categoryDescriptions.Matematik: From basic maths to calculus, geometry and discrete mathematics. Lessons that build intuition first, then reinforce it with proofs and plenty of practice, preparing you for exams and engineering.
categoryDescriptions.Coğrafya: Physical geography, geomorphology, climatology, the geography of Türkiye, map reading and Geographic Information Systems (GIS). Lessons on the processes that shape the Earth and on thinking spatially.
categoryDescriptions.Veri Bilimi & Yapay Zeka: Data analysis, statistical modelling, machine learning and deep learning. Hands-on courses that take you from cleaning data in Python to building models and reading their results honestly.
categoryDescriptions.Ekonomi & Finans: Micro and macroeconomics, monetary policy, accounting and personal finance. Courses that teach you to read markets, financial statements and economic news with confidence.
categoryDescriptions.Edebiyat & Felsefe: Turkish and world literature, the big questions of philosophy, logic and critical thinking. Courses on close reading, building an argument and writing your own interpretation.
categoryDescriptions.Fotoğrafçılık & Sinema: Digital photography, film language, film analysis and short film making. Workshops on telling stories with images by understanding light, framing and editing.

descriptions.İleri Seviye C# ve .NET API: Advanced C# features and building tested, documented REST APIs with ASP.NET Core.
descriptions.Java: Object-oriented programming in Java: classes, inheritance, collections and Streams.
descriptions.Veri Yapıları: Arrays, lists, trees, hash tables and graphs, with their time and memory costs.
descriptions.Algoritmalar: Systematic problem solving with sorting, divide and conquer, dynamic programming and graph algorithms.
descriptions.React ile Modern Web Geliştirme: Fast, accessible interfaces with React 19 and TypeScript, ending in a capstone project.
descriptions.Matematik: Numbers, equations, functions and logarithms: a solid base for exam preparation.
descriptions.Matematik Geometri: Comprehensive geometry, from triangles and circles to solids and analytic geometry.
descriptions.Ayrık Matematik: Logic, proof, combinatorics and graph theory: the mathematical foundation of computer science.
descriptions.Fizik: Mechanics, energy, electricity and optics, learned by building models rather than memorising formulas.
descriptions.Kimya: Core chemistry, from atoms and reactions to acids, bases and organic chemistry.
descriptions.Biyoloji: From the cell to the ecosystem: genetics, human physiology and ecology.
descriptions.Astronomiye Giriş: Constellations, the Solar System, the lives of stars and observing practice.
descriptions.Fiziki Coğrafya: The Earth's motions, climate, the water cycle, soils and vegetation.
descriptions.Jeomorfoloji: Landforms shaped by internal and external forces, with field examples from Türkiye.
descriptions.Türkiye Coğrafyası: Türkiye's location, landforms, climate, population and economy, region by region.
descriptions.Harita Bilgisi ve CBS: Scale, projections, reading contour lines and spatial analysis with QGIS.
descriptions.Coğrafya: A general introduction to physical, human and economic geography.
descriptions.Tarih: From the first civilisations to the Ottomans and the modern age, read through the sources.
descriptions.Cumhuriyet Tarihi: The founding and growth of the Republic of Türkiye, from the War of Independence to multi-party politics.
descriptions.İngilizce: Fluent speaking, reading and writing for learners aiming at B1-B2.
descriptions.Almanca A1: Pronunciation, articles and everyday phrases, preparing for Goethe A1.
descriptions.UI/UX Tasarımın Temelleri: End-to-end product design, from user research to a Figma prototype.
descriptions.Grafik Tasarım ve Tipografi: Composition, colour and type, with a brand-identity project.
descriptions.Karakalem ve Desen: Proportion, perspective, light and shadow, and figure drawing.
descriptions.Sanat Tarihine Giriş: From cave paintings to contemporary art, reading works in their context.
descriptions.Piyano Eğitimi: Piano for every level, from reading notes to playing with both hands.
descriptions.Gitar Eğitimi: Chords, strumming patterns, reading tabs and simple solos.
descriptions.Beden Eğitimi: Warm-ups, basic motor skills, team sports and healthy living.
descriptions.Fonksiyonel Antrenman: Fundamental movement patterns and a weekly plan for your level.
descriptions.Etkili Çalışma Teknikleri: Spaced repetition, self-testing, time management and exam anxiety.
descriptions.Topluluk Önünde Konuşma: Manage stage fright, structure your ideas and hold an audience, with a recorded talk and feedback in every lesson.
descriptions.Temel Matematik: A solid restart in numbers, fractions, ratios, percentages and first steps in algebra, built on everyday examples.
descriptions.Kalkülüs ve Analiz: Limits, derivatives, integrals and series, built on intuition first and then on systematic technique.
descriptions.Lineer Cebir: Vectors, matrices, linear maps and eigenvalues, each with a geometric picture and real applications.
descriptions.Olasılık ve İstatistik: From counting and distributions to confidence intervals and hypothesis tests, with real data and simulations.
descriptions.Python: Learn to program with Python: variables, control flow, functions, data structures, files and a small automation project.
descriptions.SQL ve Veritabanı Tasarımı: Design relational schemas and query them with SQL: joins, grouping, window functions, indexes and transactions.
descriptions.Python ile Veri Analizi: Clean, reshape and visualise real data with NumPy, pandas and seaborn, ending in an analysis report.
descriptions.Makine Öğrenmesine Giriş: Regression, classification, trees, clustering and model evaluation with scikit-learn, maths and code side by side.
descriptions.Derin Öğrenme ve Sinir Ağları: Build neural networks from scratch, then train CNNs and Transformer models with PyTorch.
descriptions.Veri Görselleştirme ve Hikâye Anlatımı: Turn numbers into honest, persuasive charts and dashboards using perception, colour and narrative.
descriptions.Mikroekonomiye Giriş: Supply and demand, elasticity, firm decisions, market structures and market failures, with current examples.
descriptions.Makroekonomi ve Para Politikası: Growth, inflation, interest rates, central banking and exchange rates, read through current data.
descriptions.Kişisel Finans ve Yatırım: Budgeting, debt, compound interest and the logic of savings and investment products. Financial literacy, not investment advice.
descriptions.Muhasebenin Temelleri: Double-entry bookkeeping, journals, the income statement and balance sheet, and ratio analysis for a small business.
descriptions.Türk Edebiyatına Giriş: From Divan poetry to the Republican novel, the main periods of Turkish literature read through key texts.
descriptions.Felsefeye Giriş: Knowledge, mind, ethics, politics and art: philosophy's big questions through short readings and careful argument.
descriptions.Mantık ve Eleştirel Düşünme: Tell strong arguments from weak ones: propositional logic, induction, fallacies, cognitive biases and source checking.
descriptions.Dijital Fotoğrafçılığın Temelleri: Leave auto mode behind: exposure, focus, light, composition and basic editing, with a shooting assignment each week.
descriptions.Sinema Dili ve Film Analizi: Framing, camera movement, mise-en-scène, editing and sound, analysed scene by scene.
descriptions.Kısa Film Yapımı: Write, shoot, record, edit and grade your own 3 to 5 minute short film.
descriptions.Sosyolojiye Giriş: Culture, inequality, cities and migration, and how sociologists study them.
descriptions.İspanyolca A1: A communicative start in Spanish: pronunciation, ser and estar, regular verbs and everyday conversations.
descriptions.Müzik Teorisi ve Kulak Eğitimi: Notation, rhythm, intervals, scales, chords and harmony, with ear training in every lesson.
descriptions.Suluboya Atölyesi: Control water and pigment: washes, wet-on-wet, colour mixing and preserving the white of the paper.
descriptions.Yoga ve Mobilite: Flows and mobility routines for every level to undo long days at a desk, no equipment needed.

help.title: Help
help.heroSubtitle: If you cannot find the answer to your question in the FAQ section, you can reach out to our expert support team.
help.faqDesc: Click on one of the questions below to view the answer.

questions.q1: How can I enroll in a course?
questions.a1: After registering, you can go to the 'Courses' page, select a course, and click the 'Enroll' button.
questions.q2: What is the application process to become a teacher?
questions.a2: When you register as a teacher, you select branches that match your competencies and submit them for admin approval.
questions.q3: I forgot my password, what should I do?
questions.a3: Password reset is not automatic yet. If you can sign in, change your password under Settings > Account; if you can't, contact the platform admin so they can verify your account and set a new password.
questions.a4: Yes, when you complete the courses with 100% success, you can receive your digital certificate added to your profile.

about.title: Learn it from *someone* who does it.
about.mission: E-Kurs is a course platform built around one idea: the best person to teach a subject is someone who practises it. Our instructors are engineers, researchers, artists and teachers who bring their daily work into every lesson.
about.mission2: Every course is a sequence of short video lessons with a public syllabus, so you know exactly what you will learn before you spend anything.
about.approachDesc: Four principles shape every course on the platform.

practice.title: Practitioners first
practice.desc: Instructors teach from what they do: real projects, real data, real field notes. Concepts arrive with the problem they solve.

syllabus.title: An open syllabus
syllabus.desc: Every course shows its full lesson list to everyone. Compare courses, check the level and decide before you sign up.

pace.title: Your own pace
pace.desc: Lessons are protected videos you can watch whenever you like, as often as you like, once you are enrolled.

support.title: People behind it
support.desc: Course announcements keep you up to date, and the help desk answers questions about payments, access and anything else.

about.guaranteeDesc: Paying for a course should be as simple as choosing one, and changing your mind should cost nothing.

topUp.title: Top up once
topUp.desc: Add funds to your wallet. Your balance and every transaction are always visible on the wallet page.

buy.title: Buy in one step
buy.desc: Purchase any course from its page. You are enrolled at once and the lessons unlock immediately.

refund.title: Refund within 7 days
refund.desc: Not the right course? Request a refund within 7 days of purchase and the full price goes straight back to your wallet.

about.guaranteeNote: Instructors receive a share of every sale (70% by default), so your purchase directly supports the people who teach you.
about.disciplinesDesc: From mathematics and software to film and philosophy, each discipline is taught by specialists in that field.
about.facultyDesc: A few of the instructors behind the catalogue. Every profile lists their background and the courses they teach.
about.ctaTitle: Read a syllabus. Start when it feels right.
